items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: Charlie Love used to be there with Charlie and Nick.

ctx.x: I think Charlie Love told me about that.
Charlie Love used to be there with Charlie and Nick. I played with Charlie for a while too. Charlie, they were moving out there. I believe he had a scoop for him. Yeah.

How about putting a cover on? Something happened to his banjo and he didn't want to spend money to buy a new and he put a cover on it when he took it down to the place and after that he began to put the head on the banjo.
